emerging_technology: Theranos proprietary finger-prick, micro-volume multi-analyte blood-testing platform (Edison/miniLab and Nanotainer claims)
intended_application: Retail direct-access clinical blood testing from a finger-prick sample using the claimed Theranos proprietary platform
industry_sector: U.S. clinical laboratory diagnostics and retail pharmacy
risk_consequence_context: Incorrect results can affect diagnosis and treatment; laboratory validation, CLIA quality, device claims, patient trust and partner liability matter.
time_horizon: Retrospective 2013–2018, evaluated with evidence public by 2026-10-24
additional_context: Retrospective evidence packet, verified 2026-10-24; later sources are hindsight, not all available in 2015. FDA K143236 decision 2015-07-02 found substantial equivalence for a specific Theranos HSV-1 IgG assay using the Theranos system and fingerstick/venous specimen types; not blanket clearance of a multi-assay platform: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cdrh_docs/reviews/k143236.pdf . FDA Form 483 issued 2015-09-16 recorded observations on Nanotainer listing and complaint handling; inspection observations are not final agency determinations: https://www.fda.gov/files/about%20fda/published/Theranos--Inc.--Newark--CA-483-Issued-09-16-2015.pdf . Walgreens said on 2016-06-12 it was terminating partnership and closing all 40 Arizona Theranos Wellness Centers, citing voided results and CMS response: https://www.walgreensbootsalliance.com/news-media/press-releases/2016/walgreens-terminates-relationship-with-theranos-will-be-closing-operations-at-all-40-theranos-wellness-centers-in-arizona . Arizona Attorney General 2017 annual report says about 1.5m tests sold to over 175,000 Arizonans during 2013-2016, 10% later voided/corrected; those are service counts, not proprietary-device counts: https://www.azag.gov/sites/default/files/publications/2024-10/2017AnnualReport.pdf . SEC 2018 release alleges the proprietary analyzer could perform only a small number of tests and most patient tests ran on modified/standard third-party analyzers; Theranos and Holmes settled without admitting allegations: https://www.sec.gov/enforcement-litigation/litigation-releases/lr-24069 . DOJ 2022 account of criminal trial evidence says Theranos voided tests run on its analyzer and records Balwani conviction, Holmes investor-fraud conviction; it calls Theranos defunct: https://www.justice.gov/usao-ndca/pr/theranos-president-sentenced-more-12-years-fraud-jeopardized-patient-health-and-bilked .
business_need: Offer convenient lab access in stores without exposing customers to unreliable testing
users_stakeholders: Customers, pharmacists, physicians, Walgreens leadership, Theranos and regulators
adoption_posture: Fast-following channel partner; interested in scaling a differentiated service
capabilities_constraints: Large retail footprint and brand reach but no direct control of proprietary analyzer performance; dependent on supplier documentation and certified labs
management_question: At the 2015–2016 partnership review, should Walgreens expand Theranos Wellness Centers or suspend/terminate the offering pending verification?
